title: The Authority of the Believer in Action
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner shares the incredible story of healing and deliverance that took place in the life of Benjamin, a young boy who was diagnosed with a serious respiratory condition, and Kara, a member of The River Church who was struggling with intense ear pain and a painful rib injury. Through their testimonies, Pastor Chris teaches on the authority of the believer and how we can stand against the enemy's attacks, trusting in the mighty name of Jesus. You won't want to miss this inspiring message of hope and faith!
